description: SessionStart hook to inject clipboard-copy MCP tool directives, and a PreToolUse hook to block native clipboard-write Bash commands and route them to the clipboard-copy MCP tools.

hooks.command: bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$root" ]; then printf "%s\n" "clipboard-copy: plugin root is unavailable" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec bash "$root/hooks/scripts/session-start.sh"'

bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$root" ]; then printf "%s\n" "clipboard-copy: plugin root is unavailable" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec bash "$root/hooks/scripts/check-clipboard.sh"'
